title: One-Sided Candidate-Only Pareto Confirmation — Software and Reproducibility Core v1.1.0
description: Software, tests, schemas, minimal example data and replayable statistical evidence for one-sided archive-relative Pareto confirmation in stochastic simulation. The unpublished manuscript and supplementary manuscript are not included. The procedure may certify a positive claim or remain undecided; it is not a total fixed-confidence identification algorithm.
notes: Software-only public record. The unpublished manuscript and supplementary manuscript are not included. The included derived data have machine-readable provenance. The DOI is assigned only when this new software record is published.
